title: Flutter ARB localization file
description: An Application Resource Bundle used by Flutter's localization generator.

type.description: The Dart type of the placeholder. When omitted, Flutter infers the type from the ICU expression or defaults it to Object.

format.description: A NumberFormat or DateFormat name. Date formats may be joined with +. Custom date patterns require isCustomDateFormat to be true.

isCustomDateFormat.description: Whether format contains a custom DateFormat pattern. Flutter accepts a boolean or the strings "true" and "false".

description.description: A description of the placeholder for translators.

optionalParameters.description: Optional named parameters passed to a NumberFormat constructor.

type.description: The resource type used by localization tools.

context.description: The context in which this resource is used.

placeholders.description: Placeholder metadata keyed by placeholder name.

description.description: A description of the message for translators.

comment.description: A comment that is not intended to be sent to translators.

@@locale.description: The locale of this ARB file. Required because this language server does not infer a locale from the filename.

@@context.description: The context in which all resources in this file apply.

@@last_modified.description: The last modification time in ISO 8601 format.

@@author.description: The author or translator of these messages.

@@comment.description: A top-level comment that is not intended to be sent to translators.

^(?!@).+$.description: A localized ICU message keyed by its resource ID.
